strings.bed_choice_nearest: When time runs out, wake in the nearest known bed.
strings.bed_choice_click: Click a bed to choose. Double-click to place a map pin.
strings.bed_choice_keys: Map, Esc, or gamepad B: confirm. Gamepad A: choose at the map center.
strings.cfg_sleep__enabled_help: Ember's multiplayer sleep. Off: the game's own sleep and no sleep HUD.
strings.cfg_sleep__use_vanilla_sleep_window_help: On: the game's sleep window and skip rule, and no partial sleep boost.
strings.cfg_sleep__sleep_start_help: Day fraction from which beds can be used (0.5 is noon). Sleep ends at morning (0.25).
strings.cfg_sleep__partial_sleep_boost_help: While some but not all players are in bed, the night passes faster. Off: only the all-in-bed skip.
strings.cfg_sleep__bonus_multiplier_help: Extra rate = Bonus Multiplier x sleeping / (players - 1) x Bonus Increment Scale. Defaults give 12 (13x speed) with all but one in bed.
strings.cfg_sleep__bonus_increment_scale_help: Scales how much each sleeping player speeds up the night while others stay awake. Multiplied with Bonus Multiplier; 0 turns the partial-sleep speedup off.
strings.cfg_sleep__boost_fade_seconds_help: Real seconds before morning over which the boost ramps down to none. 0: hard stop at morning.
strings.cfg_sleep__wake_at_window_end_help: When morning comes without a full skip, everybody in bed wakes up.
strings.cfg_sleep__sleep_in_any_bed_help: Sleep in a bed another player has claimed. The bed keeps its owner and your spawn point does not change; the game's time, roof, fire, wet and enemy checks still apply. The host decides; on by default.
strings.cfg_sleep__stand_up_on_respawn_help: After death, skip the getting-up animation when you respawn. Logging in and first-spawn flight keep the game's behavior. Requires Ember's Sleep module; off by default.
strings.cfg_sleep__nearest_owned_bed_respawn_hel: After death, respawn at your nearest known owned bed. With at least two candidates and maps allowed, choose a bed on the native map for up to 30 seconds; timeout keeps the nearest. Map, Escape, or gamepad B confirms. Destroyed or reclaimed beds fall back to another known bed, then world start. Requires Sleep Enabled. Off by default; normal login is unchanged.
strings.cfg_sleep__quick_respawn_help: Shorten death and bed-loading waits near your respawn destination, up to the game's normal wait at 1,000 meters. Confirming a map bed choice skips the remaining waits; native area, bed and remote arrival checks still apply. With this option off, confirmation keeps the remaining native death delay and full loading wait. Requires Sleep Enabled; also works without nearest-bed selection. Disabling preserves pending requests and stops later acceleration. Off by default.
strings.cfg_sleep__show_owned_beds_on_map_help: Requires Nearest Owned Bed Respawn and Sleep Enabled. Show learned owned beds for your character in this world as temporary yellow icons on the minimap and large map. The native bound-bed icon remains and your bed filter is preserved. Death-choice candidates appear even with this display off; temporary choice filters are restored afterward. Does not discover unknown beds.
strings.cfg_sleep__sleep_any_time_help: Cheat. Beds work at any time of day (the wake-up cooldown still applies). Off whenever the server blocks cheats.
strings.cfg_sleep__testing_mode_help: Cheat. Adds Fake Total Players and Simulate Players In Bed to the real counts. Off whenever the server blocks cheats.
strings.cfg_sleep__fake_total_players_help: Players added to the count while Testing Mode is on.
strings.cfg_sleep__simulate_players_in_bed_help: Sleepers added while Testing Mode is on (at most Fake Total Players).
strings.cfg_sleep_hud__show_help: Show the sleep panel under the minimap during the sleep window.
strings.cfg_sleep_hud__compact_above_help: With more players than this, one pillow and a count are shown.
strings.cfg_station_timers__protect_cooking_time: During the partial sleep boost, food on cooking stations and in ovens cooks and burns at normal speed.
strings.cfg_station_timers__protect_smelter_time: During the partial sleep boost, smelters, blast furnaces, kilns and similar stations work at normal speed.
strings.cfg_station_timers__protect_crop_timers_: During the partial sleep boost, crops and saplings grow at normal speed.
strings.cfg_station_timers__protect_mead_timers_: During the partial sleep boost, fermenters ferment at normal speed.
strings.cfg_station_timers__protect_pickable_tim: During the partial sleep boost, berry bushes and other pickables regrow at normal speed.
strings.cfg_ocean_boat_physics__decouple_water_w: While the night is accelerated, ocean waves move at normal real-time speed instead of boosted time.
strings.cfg_ocean_boat_physics__calm_ocean_durin: Ocean waves are calmed and smoothed while the night is accelerated.
strings.cfg_ocean_boat_physics__ocean_calm_multi: Wave height multiplier while calming is active (0 is flat, 1 is normal).
strings.cfg_ocean_boat_physics__prevent_boat_sle: Boats take no spurious wave impact damage during accelerated sleep.
strings.cfg_ocean_boat_physics__suppress_boat_im: No camera shake from fast wave wakes during accelerated sleep.
strings.cfg_torches__enabled_help: Torches act like a campfire: warmth, resting and the bed's fire check.
strings.cfg_torches__fire_pieces_help: Comma list of piece prefab names that act as fire while lit.
strings.cfg_torches__held_torch_warms_help: A lit torch held in hand keeps the player warm like a campfire.
strings.cfg_torches__environment_affects_torch_h: Rain and storms make a held torch burn at Burn Rate.
strings.cfg_torches__cold_biome_affects_torch_he: The Mountains and the Deep North make a held torch burn at Burn Rate.
strings.cfg_torches__burn_rate_help: Durability a held torch loses per second under the two rules above.
strings.cfg_torches__endless_torches_help: Cheat. Held torches lose no durability and listed fire pieces use no fuel. Off whenever the server blocks cheats.
strings.cfg_torches__fuel_free_fires_help: The five standard placed torches and campfires burn without consuming fuel, including at zero stock; held torches lose no durability. Stored fuel and durability stay unchanged. Requires Ember's Torches module.
strings.cfg_torches__smokeless_fires_help: The five standard placed torches, campfires and held torches produce no smoke. Other fires keep their behavior. Requires Ember's Torches module.
strings.cfg_torches__torches_night_only_help: Player-built Torch Pieces light at night and go out by day, removing their warmth while off. Requires Ember's Torches module and steps aside for OpenKeep. Off relights torches this schedule put out; visit your bases before removing Ember.
strings.cfg_torches__torch_pieces_help: Comma list of placed fire prefab names switched by Torches Night Only. Independent of Fire Pieces warmth and fuel-free fire eligibility.
strings.cfg_torches__torch_margin_help: In-game hours to light before nightfall and remain lit after daybreak. Zero follows the native night exactly.
strings.cfg_torches__torch_switch_key_help: While looking at a scheduled torch, keep it lit or return it to the night schedule. Requires ward access. Empty disables the key.
strings.cfg_doors__auto_doors_allowed_help: Off turns automatic doors off for every player.
strings.cfg_doors__enable_auto_door_help: Doors open as you walk up and close behind you.
strings.cfg_doors__keep_open_while_others_near_h: Never close a door while another player is within its close distance.
strings.cfg_doors__toggle_key_help: Key that turns Enable Auto Door on or off. Empty: no key.
